title: Singleton accuracy reciprocal bound
statement: Let $n\geq 0$ and $C,Q\in\mathbb{N}$. Let $t$ be a positive rational number and let $\varepsilon$ be a rational number with $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$. Assume $1\leq n$, $1/(Q+1)\leq\varepsilon$, and $t\leq(C+1)(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)$. Define $d=\lceil 8t/\varepsilon\rceil$, $T=(\varepsilon/8)^2/t^2\,(1/9)^d$, and $a=\min(T/4,1/2)$. Then $a^{-2}\leq 16\cdot 2^{(((8(C+1)(Q+1))^4+8(8(C+1)(Q+1)+1)+4)(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1))}$.
hypotheses_covered: $n$ is a natural number and $1\leq n$
